title: Allerseelen
identity: Allerseelen is Richard Strauss’s 1885 art song, arranged for alto saxophone and piano by Harold Walters in the cataloged Rubank edition. Rubank lists the arrangement in Grade 2, 8 pages, an external vendor detail that is not a SaxoBrain level.

evidence.claim: Catalog lead identifies Rubank RUBX841, arranger Harold Walters, Grade 2 and 8 pages.
Music reference describes Strauss’s Allerseelen as a 1885 song setting Hermann von Gilm’s poem.
Rubank catalog lists Allerseelen as Strauss / Walters.

review_focus: Inference: inspect the adapted vocal line for phrase length, breathing and accompaniment balance; avoid treating grade label as Tim’s level.
collection_flag: Arrangement of a vocal song, not original saxophone repertoire; Rubank Grade 2 descriptor is external publisher/vendor classification.
gaps: Original song’s piano accompaniment may differ from saxophone edition.
